product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to connect professionals with paid consulting, advisory and research opportunities, helping companies find relevant human expertise.

pricing_page.notes: Ethos Evals has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both appear under “Companies hiring with Ethos.”

employee_band.notes: Available headcount figures do not establish a reliable current match to any of the five permitted bands.

hq_location.notes: The internal support posting explicitly identifies its London HQ in Kings Cross.

eng_blog.notes: The updates index contains product announcements rather than engineering-authored articles about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Ethos Evals publishes MCP setup, authentication, workflow, billing and extensive tool-reference documentation; product access itself is invite-only.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official AI Engineer posting is closed; no qualifying open role was displayed on the investor job-board page.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list explicitly identifies these providers for AI and language-processing services.

compliance_certs.notes: The DPA claims UK GDPR and, where applicable, EU GDPR compliance. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 appear as illustrative audit-report examples, not confirmed certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 6, 2026 Series A falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A complete current list of Ethos's own sales vacancies could not be verified; marketplace opportunities were not treated as internal hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: On November 6, 2026, Ethos announced the private beta of its model-evaluation platform.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated qualifying executive arrival or departure was verified, and no complete leadership roster with tenure dates was available.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Listed for B2B sales intelligence, lead generation and email discovery; this does not establish deployment of a particular CRM.
